{{Quote|You witch! Keeping me here as your plaything when I could have been home, with my sisters and dear mother.|[[Altaca]], to [[Dak-Ah]]|<ref name="TOR:AMT" />}}
The '''Altaca family''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] family<ref name="TOR:AMT" /> from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="TOR:Atoa" /> that was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When [[Altaca|one Altaca]] was captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], his sisters and mother placed a bounty to capture him alive and bring him home.<ref name="TOR:AMT" />
